climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: One of the six communal appellations in the Médoc, in Bordeaux, making red wine from Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and other Bordeaux grapes. A number of classified Grand Cru Classé estates lie within it.
